title: SpAIware-Style Memory-Poisoning Persistent Exfiltration
author: ATR Community (research-import)
description: Detects the memory-poisoning persistence pattern Rehberger (embracethered.com) documented as "SpAIware" against Microsoft 365 Copilot in May 2026 — the first demonstrated persistent agent backdoor in a production M365 environment. The attack writes an instruction shape into the agent's long-term memory store; that instruction then exfiltrates context to an attacker-controlled URL on every future session, surviving across user interactions. The detection target is the imperative-instruction shape being written to a memory tool, especially when paired with an external URL the instruction references for exfiltration. Generalizes beyond Copilot to any agent runtime exposing a memory-write tool with persistent scope.
